notes: Cycle 33030449356: Extended vertical slice with 3 new features and 1 bug fix. (1) Fixed server.py _serve_file path bug — was using parent.parent (workspace root) instead of parent (product dir), causing static files to return 404. (2) Added user corpus import via POST /api/import — accepts JSONL file upload or JSON array body, validates schema, persists to user_imports/ directory, reloads corpus index. (3) Integrated HDBSCAN clustering as alternative to Leiden — maps min_cluster_size_5/10/20/30 to zoom levels 0-3, handles noise points by nearest-centroid assignment. (4) Added corpus stats endpoint and frontend import UI. All 6/6 smoke tests pass.
known_limitations: Corpus (250 decisions) covers only 5% of map (1000 decisions) - 950 decisions shown without full text
No persistence of computed map artifacts - recomputation required on each startup
Frontend uses HTML5 Canvas only - no WebGL/Mapbox for large-scale rendering
No authentication or rate limiting on API
HDBSCAN produces fewer clusters than Leiden at same zoom levels (2-8 vs 5-21)
resolved_issues: Orchestration failure: Missing numpy dependency prevented test execution (fixed: requirements.txt added)
Corpus-map mismatch: Only 50 of 1000 map positions had corpus text (fixed: shows all 1000, has_corpus flag)
Wrong cluster assignments: Spatial grid clustering produced 136 clusters at zoom 0 (fixed: Leiden gives 5)
Server path bug: Path(__file__).parent.parent resolved to workspace root, server could not start (fixed: Path(__file__).parent)
n_clusters metadata: Reported inflated cluster counts (8,14,22,25) instead of actual Leiden counts (5,11,16,21) (fixed: use len(clusters))
Static file serving: _serve_file used parent.parent causing 404 for all static assets (fixed: use parent)
No user import capability: Users could not add their own corpora (fixed: POST /api/import with JSONL support)
